messages:
miguel: quick telemetry check for TelemetryCo — can we confirm token usage / throughput trends for the week? planning a short sync with AM tomorrow.
sara: got the raw numbers from clemens, dropping highlights below. overall runway looks OK but noticed a latency bump on eu-west on Wed.
clemens-analytics: pasted the trimmed view (QoW and QoQ). small table:
```
metric            | this_week | prev_week | QoW %  | prev_quarter | QoQ %
------------------|-----------|-----------|--------|--------------|-------
tokens_total      | 12.4M     | 9.8M      | +26.5% | 37.2M        | +33.3%
requests_per_sec  | 320       | 260       | +23.1% | 280          | +14.3%
p50 latency (ms)  | 92        | 78        | +17.9% | 85           | +8.2%
error_rate (%)    | 0.9       | 0.6       | +50%   | 0.7          | +28.6%
weekly_spend ($)  | 5,400     | 4,200     | +28.6% | 15,800       | +34.2%
```
miguel: thanks. error_rate jump to 0.9% is small but trend is upward. do we know error class breakdown?
clemens-analytics: majority are 429s from bursty inference spikes (not model errors). small portion (0.08%) are 5xx from node OOMs during long context runs.
sara: context — TelemetryCo increased prompt lengths on Mon and enabled streaming. that explains both higher tokens and slightly higher p50.
jess: note on onboarding: they finished the integration checklist, but asked for an optimization session to lower spend — scheduled Tue 10am with solutions eng.
ops-bot: deploy finished on eu-west (runtime v2.3.1) at 1761234700. no rollbacks.
miguel: action items:
- jess: run spend optimization session, focus on batching + prefix cache (owner: jess)
- eng/runtime: validate OOM traces and tune max_context or chunking (owner: eng-runtime)
- clemens: add breakdown of 429 sources (by route + time) for tomorrow
sara: renewal health: usage up QoQ which is good; but we should prioritize cost plan before next invoice cycle. I'll flag as "engaged" not "at_risk" for now.
miguel: perfect. anything else? if not, I'll summarize in the account doc and ping AM.
sara: all good from me. :+1:
jess: on it — will share optimization checklist after session.
clemens-analytics: posting an attach with raw CSV in the account folder now: /mnt/telemetryco/weekly_metrics/1761234567.csv
miguel: thanks team, closing thread — will follow up post-session.
